title: El Uber
subtitle: The Rideshare
premise: You order an Uber to Colonia Roma. The driver is chatty, takes a different route, and you're not sure if you're going the wrong way or if there's just traffic. Also his phone is blasting norteño music.
setting: Inside a beat-up silver Nissan navigating Mexico City traffic. The smell of pine air freshener and street food drifting through the window. Construction everywhere.

characters.name: Memo
characters.role: Rideshare driver, also has a side business selling tamales
characters.personality: Extremely talkative, proud of his city, speaks rapid CDMX slang

arc: Getting in → Memo explains a detour → You misunderstand and panic → He reassures you → You practice small talk → Arriving at Roma, he tells you his tamale stand address
